proves.claim: commitPrepared refuses a function, a non-array statements value or a statement without a sql string with PREPARED_WRITE_REQUIRED and opens no transaction.

store.io-board-write-sequencer.refuses-c.why: The sequencer takes data, never a callback, so no Git, file, network or history scan can run inside the transaction.

proves.claim: A prepared write of several statements commits in one recorded transaction naming its move, returns each statement's changes and lastInsertRowid, and leaves no row when a statement fails.

store.io-board-write-sequencer.one-trans.why: Every board write must be one recorded hold that either commits whole or not at all.

proves.claim: A 20-statement prepared write on a fixture board commits with its best recorded hold under 50 ms of five.

store.io-board-write-sequencer.commit-fa.why: A prepared write holds the board lock only for its statements, so the hold stays short.
